رَضَّاحٌ [That breaks, or bruises, pebbles &c. much or vehemently]. Abu-n-Nejm says, “بِكُلِّ وَأْبٍ لِلْحَصَى رَضَّاحِ
لَيْسَ بِمُصْطَرٍّ وَلَا فِرْشَاحِ
” [With every strong hoof, that breaks the pebbles much or vehemently, that is not contracted, or immoderately narrow, nor spreading]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
